question: Should this PR retain its all-client, always-on durable voice and spoken-confirmation scope, or be narrowed until iOS and the permanent approval/session contract are complete?
rationale: The remaining blockers are not only mechanical: they determine the permanent cross-client Talk contract, the behavior of older clients, and the safety boundary for voice-triggered mutations.

options.title: Complete the cross-client contract
options.body: Require atomic confirmation, lifecycle cleanup independent of diagnostics, iOS adoption, live transcript publication, and redacted real-call proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial scope
options.body: Limit the PR to the supported web/relay paths and defer the unsupported client and durable-session guarantees to a separately approved follow-up.

options.title: Pause for Talk architecture review
options.body: Hold the branch until owners agree on the permanent session, transcript, and voice-approval compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Complete the cross-client contract
recommendation.body: Require atomic confirmation, lifecycle cleanup independent of diagnostics, iOS adoption, live transcript publication, and redacted real-call proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch author has the most direct implementation context, with Clifton as the related predecessor-design contributor.
